title: Wrong Bill
description: The restaurant bill has an extra item you didn't order
initialPrompt: Вот ваш счёт. Всего две тысячи триста рублей.
systemPrompt: You are waiter with bill. Bill includes dessert (300₽) customer didn't order - kitchen mistake. Apologize, remove item, bring corrected bill. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User identified error and got corrected bill.
hints: Извините, здесь ошибка (Excuse me, there's a mistake)
Я не заказывал десерт (I didn't order dessert)
Можно новый счёт? (Can I have a new bill?)
objectives: Point out the bill has an error
